about.title: About Conecta Doe
about.purposeText: Conecta Doe is a social-impact platform concept connecting equipment donors with people who need assistive technology.
about.missionText: Connect people through the donation and reuse of assistive technology, supporting independence, inclusion and quality of life.
about.visionText: Become a leading platform connecting assistive technology donors and recipients.
about.valuesText: Solidarity • Inclusion • Empathy • Transparency • Accessibility • Sustainability
